high_level_description: This image is a fashion photograph featuring a model posing dynamically against a plain gray background. The model is wearing a flowing white dress with a large, vibrant red poppy flower printed on the lower half of the skirt. The dress has a one-shoulder design, and the model's hair is long and dark, flowing freely as if caught in motion. The model is striking a confident pose with one hand on her hip and the other arm extended outward, giving the impression of movement and grace. She is also wearing gold sandals that complement the dress.
